annotations.title: Set the line mode of a tracked product

description: Sets what Sweeprice does with the prices of one tracked product: alert_only (watch and alert), repricing (recommend a price against the same marketplace), cross_marketplace (against every marketplace, Pro plan and up) or discovery (find the price buyers accept for a product with no direct competitor). With `channelId`, the mode applies to that marketplace only.
name: set_product_line_mode
title: Set the line mode of a tracked product
